en: The Sūtra of the Three Dhāraṇīs, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Divākara under Imperial Decree.

*Namo satvārya-dhīkagaṇāṃ tathāgatānām | Oṃ vīra śiviraśi mahākāra vajrī sata sata sarate sarate taraye taraye vidamani saṃpannayani traimati siddha-ajri-tāye svāhā.* If one recites this *dhāraṇī* twenty-one times, one shall immediately enter all *maṇḍala* altars; whatever one undertakes shall be accomplished through the recitation of this mantra.
There is the Body Seal (kāyamudrā) and the Hand Seal (hastamudrā).
If one forms these seals while reciting the mantra, the rite will be easily accomplished.
This applies even if one has not yet entered the maṇḍala.
One must not perform [this rite] haphazardly.
Now, I shall have you recite this mantra;
you shall then enter the mandala, form the mudrās, and carry out the practice, which does not constitute the method of theft.

2. Sūryaprabha Bodhisattva Dhāraṇī Homage to the Buddha Guṇamati! Homage to the Dharma! Great Homage to the Saṃgha! Tadyathā: *kili bubi saṃmudde daṇḍanam*. If one recites this dhāraṇī, all obstacles will be extinguished; it can also ward off demons and eliminate celestial calamities.
Furthermore, if one recites the mantra once and prostrates to the Buddha once,
and performs this recitation and prostration three times each day,
one shall in the future obtain the karmic fruit of possessing two marks of physical perfection.
3. The Mantra of Mārīcī. The Mantra of Mārīcī: Oṃ mārīcyai sarvasattvāvatāraśarīrasvahā. Reciting this mantra provides supreme protection for the human body.
On that day, recite each of the three dhāraṇīs one hundred and eight times during each of the three periods.
